rn-rtx.short: raw-native parity run on an RTX 4090
claims: Tensor-core path max absolute difference 0.106689 at frame 48, pixel 64580; scalar fp32 path 0.00290298; 64 frames, 24,883,200 values each; p99.99 upper 0.00176668 for the tensor-core path; the perturbed-weights control fails as required.
rn-rtx.n: 64 frames of raw_hero_p7, 24,883,200 values per path.
rn-rtx.interval: None; maxima and quantiles of one run.
rn-rtx.does_not_prove: Behaviour on other GPUs, other scenes or other network versions.

rn-bounds.citation: HarperZ9/raw-native at 9de6582, evidence/rr-inference-bounds.json and the parity measure in vk_rrnet.cpp.
claims: The parity bound: maximum absolute difference at most 1e-2, measured per value in double over every value.
rn-bounds.does_not_prove: That 1e-2 is the right bound for image quality; it is the bound set in advance.

rn-note.short: raw-native evidence note on the tensor-core parity miss, 15 October 2026
claims: Predictions written before the emulation; weights-only hypothesis refuted; single-sample specular fireflies (radiance 1,087 beside neighbours near 0.1, demodulated by 0.05 to about 21,700, filtered to about 105 against a reference of 110); per-layer and mixed-precision results; decision: no change this round and the bound is not loosened.
rn-note.does_not_prove: That PyTorch's emulation reproduces the tensor cores' summation order.

rn-emu.short: raw-native CPU emulations W, A and WA
rn-emu.citation: HarperZ9/raw-native at 9de6582, evidence/rr-tc-2026-10-15/emu-W.json, emu-A.json, emu-WA.json (commit a0e2cc0).
rn-emu.does_not_prove: The GPU's exact arithmetic; it agrees on the worst location and the order of the miss.

rn-mixed.does_not_prove: That no other mixed-precision split would pass.

ours-denoiser.short: Night School's small re-creation of the denoiser's arithmetic
ours-denoiser.citation: media/school/denoiser/facts.json, written by tools/school/fill_denoiser.mjs from system/school/denoiser.mjs: one convolution step and the 5 x 5 softmax filter with a synthetic glint of the note's magnitudes, in fp32, fp16 and bf16 variants, against raw-native's own bound and measure.
claims: The re-created tensor-core arithmetic misses at the glint pixel and the fp32 path passes; without the glint every variant passes.
ours-denoiser.n: One synthetic 32 x 18 case (seed 1) and a 200-seed sweep.
ours-denoiser.does_not_prove: Anything numeric about raw-native's network: the real frame, weights and 12 layers are not in its evidence, so every re-created number is synthetic.

ours-precision.does_not_prove: Anything about the denoiser by itself.
